arguments.title: Historical note — Park Slope apartment, September 22, 2023
arguments.body: On September 22, 2023, Alex and Devika felt that their Park Slope one-bedroom was beginning to seem like a phase they might outgrow. Kibo pacing around the apartment made the space constraint feel more immediate. They were considering how Devika’s post-residency work choice should protect home life, including predictable weekends, fewer indefinite night blocks, and a manageable commute. They had not chosen her career path—and explicitly had not begun an apartment search.
